quest.title: A Whole New Craftshop
quest.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts in collecting materials, the Krumkake Craftshop's workbench has a spanking new groove...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Aino's console has gotten even more advanced!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! Got more scrap for me? Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, thanks to your help, I can now announce that the Krumkake Craftshop console upgrade plan is complete! Hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Which means, I'm good on materials for now. But, don't be a stranger! You can come hang out with me and Ineffa any time!
